loci.rationale: preference() is the withdrawal entrypoint: same route/validation as opt-in, and on ('insights','off') it cancels queued 'report' jobs scoped to that owner's cases (cid IN SELECT id FROM cases WHERE owner=?), leaving the other borrower's queued report untouched.
The /preference POST route dispatches to store.preference with the submitted purpose/value, so switching off uses the identical form and route as switching on (symmetric withdrawal).

Privacy-choices UI renders a 'Switch off' control for an enabled purpose via the same /preference form, and states insights are optional and withdrawable at any time — the as-easy-as-opt-in control and prior information.
NOTICE text informs beforehand that insights require separate optional consent, can be switched off as easily as on, and that withdrawal applies to future processing.
drain() selects only state='queued' jobs and skips non-score jobs on restricted cases; cancelled report jobs are therefore not re-executed on a second drain (no retry path).
Execution-time gate: a 'report' job only produces output when enabled(db, owner, 'insights') is true, so withdrawn consent blocks generation even if a report job remained queued.
enabled() reads the latest choice per owner/purpose, making the gate owner-scoped so the unaffected subscriber's consent still evaluates true.
Job state is persisted after processing, so a completed or cancelled job is not re-run by subsequent drains.

output.path_summary: Opt-in and withdrawal both flow through the /preference POST route (app.py:0085-0087) into store.preference (store.py:0092-0098), which appends a choices row and, on insights-off, cancels queued 'report' jobs for that owner's cases only. Prior information is supplied by NOTICE (store.py:0009) and the privacy-choices copy (views.py:0033-0036). Report generation is gated at execution time by enabled(owner,'insights') (store.py:0088-0090, 0137-0139), and drain() only picks state='queued' jobs (store.py:0124-0128) with state persisted (store.py:0143), so cancelled reports are not retried. Owner-scoped cancellation and the per-owner enabled() check preserve the unaffected borrower's queued report. Static reading only; no execution.
missing_boundaries: No runtime verification: the scenario's 'drained twice' outcome is stipulated, not observed; no database was opened or drain executed.
No separate retry/backoff mechanism exists in the supplied source; 'retries' are represented only by repeated drain() calls over state='queued' jobs.
No upstream or hidden implementation is assessed; only app.py, store.py, views.py and style.css are supplied.
Promotions/objection withdrawal paths are out of scope for this rule and not relied upon.
